masterResume.summary: Flutter Developer (3.8 Years) with proven expertise building high-performance cross-platform iOS and Android mobile applications using Flutter, Dart, SQLite, and Hive.

highlights: Built cross-platform Flutter applications using BLoC state management and Firebase backend integrations.
Engineered offline caching layer using SQLite and Hive local key-value databases.
Developed mobile feature modules for iOS and Android using Flutter & Dart.
Integrated RESTful API endpoints and state management.
Managed tech team operations and contributed to Flutter application development.
